evidence.detail: rs/l/f/l is a ten-value enum whose exact constants survive as DETACHED, DYNAMIC, TOP_LEFT, TOP_CENTER, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, ABOVE_CHATBOX_RIGHT, CANVAS_TOP_RIGHT and TOOLTIP.
rs/l/f/g stores rs/l/f/l as the overlay's configured/current position state, exposes getters/setters for that state, and defaults new overlays to TOP_LEFT.
rs/l/f/c maps the fixed position values to dedicated screen rectangles, while rs/l/f/m computes the corresponding anchor point and layout geometry for each position.

rs/l/f/i resolves each overlay's effective rs/l/f/l value before rendering, treats DETACHED, DYNAMIC and TOOLTIP as special placement modes, and uses fixed-position rectangles/anchor points for the remaining positions.

The overlay manager reads/writes this exact enum through the overlay settings/configuration path, including runtime position overrides, showing it is the persisted overlay-position contract rather than a transient draw hint.

proposals.note: OverlayPosition is fixed by the exact placement constants and exclusive use as the overlay system's configured/effective position enum across geometry, rendering and persistence. Confidence is 0.999.
